Spanish PM Sanchez faces EU criticism over Ceuta migrant influx

Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez faced criticism from European Union officials regarding the handling of a migrant crisis in Ceuta. The situation involved a significant influx of migrants into the Spanish enclave in North Africa. Sanchez addressed the criticism, defending Spain's actions and border management. The EU's concerns centered on border control and the management of migration flows into European territory.
